decisions.reason: Audio and web conferencing is a commoditised add-on far from the firm's infrastructure core and likely falls short of aspirations against cloud collaboration competitors, but the firm's slack lets it carry the service for now.
A metropolitan data centre connection network draws directly on owned fibre and carrier-neutral data centres and fits the strategic direction, so it is likely to meet aspirations.
Optical spectrum connectivity has its own web page and suits high-bandwidth enterprise and carrier customers, which signals strategic commitment and good performance relative to aspirations.
The voice number ordering portal is a low-cost software tool that supports the existing voice and partner business, so there is little pressure to search for other uses of its resources.
Carrier pre-selection telephony is in a declining legacy market likely to miss aspirations, but its revenue and low cost on the existing network make keeping it another year plausible.
A direct voice network connection is core to SIP and enterprise voice services and builds on owned infrastructure, so it likely meets expectations.
